items.title: Tubulis Doses First Patient in Phase I/IIa Trial Investigating ADC ...
items.summary: Tubulis announced today that the first patient has been treated in its first Phase I/IIa trial (NAPISTAR 1-01, NCT06303505). The study is evaluating Tubulis’ next-generation antibody-drug conjugate (ADC) TUB-040 in patients with platinum-resistant high-grade ovarian cancer (PROC) or relapsed/refractory adenocarcinoma non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC), who have exhausted other available treatment options. TUB-040 targets NaPi2b, a highly overexpressed antigen in ovarian cancer and lung adenocarcinoma. The candidate is the first to enter the clinic from the company’s growing pipeline and represents one of Tubulis’ two lead candidates developed using its proprietary suite of platform technologies, which enable the creation of uniquely matched ADCs with superior biophysical properties.

This international team will invest in growth technology opportunities across European markets, drawing upon an extensive and complementary track record in venture capital, growth and private equity.
